ownerAudit.successPath: LayaInferenceRunner.Run scopes one owner with using. Dispose atomically invalidates Inputs, releases five OrtValues in reverse order, and keeps the batch／attention-mask arrays alive through release.
ownerAudit.partialConstructionFailure: Create catches tensor factory failure and disposes values already created; disposal exceptions are aggregated with the construction exception.
ownerAudit.runOnlyPath: Each RunOnlyWorker owns a fixed LayaInputTensorOwner; bounded workers drain before scenario owners are disposed.

ownerAudit.successPath: RunOptions and IDisposableReadOnlyCollection<OrtValue> outputs are scoped with using; outputs are copied to managed arrays before native collection disposal.
ownerAudit.failurePath: The same scopes release inputs／RunOptions／returned outputs after native Run or output validation/copy errors.
ownerAudit.runOnlyPath: Run-only workers retain their own RunOptions and inputs; each per-request output collection is disposed.

ownerAudit.successPath: A successfully initialized InferenceSession transfers to LayaOnnxSession; SessionOptions are disposed in finally. Session.Dispose atomically clears and releases the native session.
ownerAudit.initializationFailure: Open disposes an untransferred session and always disposes SessionOptions; CPU provider setup disposes options if append fails.

ownerAudit.successPath: LayaDecisionEngine.Dispose releases tokenizer then session idempotently. LayaTokenizer owns its native tokenizer handle and disposes it atomically.
ownerAudit.initializationFailure: Engine Open disposes loaded tokenizer/session on failure; tokenizer Load disposes a partially created tokenizer in finally unless ownership transfers.

ownerAudit.owner: Probe scenario execution and run-only workers
ownerAudit.successPath: Scenario shutdown drains workers, disposes each worker owner, then releases engine/session/tokenizer. Arrays remain managed and are retained only by batch/owner references.
ownerAudit.partialFailure: Scenario creation disposes partially acquired resources; Run-only worker creation disposes its input owner if RunOptions construction fails.

lifecycleDisposition.finding: Source review and covered tests found no confirmed undisposed owner. Session-recreate has residual process memory after disposal; the difference between 10 and 100 cycles is small, but it is not source-attributed or established as a bounded allocator plateau. Full-pipeline managed-heap late segments have unavailable observations, and the v3 shape stage is partial; no Leak Confirmed/No Leak Evidence classification is supported.
